nodes.name: WAHA Webhook
nodes.notes: WAHA POSTs every incoming message here. responseMode=onReceived means n8n replies 200 OK immediately, then continues processing asynchronously.

nodes.name: Filter & Detect Intent
nodes.notes: Strict whitelist: only chats in ALLOWED_CHATS get a response (both groups @g.us and individual contacts @c.us). Empty list = bot paused. Returns empty array to stop execution if not whitelisted or no search intent found.

nodes.name: Search Listings
nodes.notes: Calls the Supabase Edge Function. Google Places is the PRIMARY source. If a manually-added DB listing has a matching name, it enriches that Google result (adds price, phone, listing-page link). Unique DB-only listings are appended after Google results.

nodes.name: Format Reply
nodes.notes: Link logic uses _source from the Edge Function: (a) DB + enriched (maps_url stored) → 🔗 listing page + 🗺️ Maps link; (b) DB not yet enriched → 🔗 listing page only; (c) Google-only result → 🗺️ Maps link only.

nodes.name: Send via WAHA
nodes.notes: Sends the reply back to the WhatsApp group via WAHA REST API. The URL uses the Docker service name 'waha' (internal Docker network).
